screen.randomblockplacement.gradient.hel: The first placed block anchors the gradient. Non-empty block items in hotbar slots 1-9 form an ordered palette, spread across the chosen total length (including the anchor). Place blocks in any order; positions beyond the length use the final palette block. The anchor resets when you leave the world.
message.randomblockplacement.gradient_ac: Random block placement is unavailable while gradient mode is active.
message.randomblockplacement.random_acti: Gradient placement is unavailable while random placement mode is active.
